thread.title: Taiwan Semi stock falls after outlook misses expectations - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Taiwan Semi stock falls after outlook misses expectations - MarketWatch

organizations.name: emily bary reporter shares of taiwan semiconductor manuf

text: Shares of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. TSM, +1.39% are down 0.4% in Thursday morning trading after the company reported December-quarter results that topped expectations but delivered a disappointing outlook for the March period. Taiwan Semi projected $7.3 billion to $7.4 billion in March-quarter revenue, significantly below the $8.5 billion consensus estimate listed on FactSet. Issues with high-end smartphones, including Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +0.33% iPhone, are weighing on the company, Evercore ISI analyst C.J. Muse wrote. This is "amplified by an inventory digestion which is expected to persist until mid-2019," he said. Analysts remain uncertain about the timing of a semiconductor recovery. Shares of Taiwan Semi have dropped 17.7% in the past 12 months, as the S&P 500 SPX, +0.63% has fallen 6.7% and the PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX, +1.18% has lost 13.4%.
